description: The Mayor's Office evaluates and responds to solicitation letters from individuals and organizations requesting financial or material assistance from the City Government of Calamba.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Solicitation letter (for organizations: must include signatures of all officers)
Price quotation for the requested items or assistance
Voter's ID (photocopy)

clientSteps.action: Submit the solicitation letter and required documents (price quotation, photocopy of Voter's ID) to the designated MOPAC staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the documents; record the request in the log.

clientSteps.action: Wait for a call from the office regarding the status of the request.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Certify the solicitation letter and issue a MOPAC receipt copy to the client; record the request; forward to the Executive Assistant IV or the Mayor for approval; notify the client when the check or assistance is ready for pickup.
clientSteps.personResponsible: Executive Assistant Staff, Executive Assistant IV, Mayor, Bookbinder III, Security Agent I

processingTime: 15 minuto (initial processing); check released within 20 working days
notes: Check processing goes through the Finance Committee and is completed within twenty (20) working days.

sources.name: City Government of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Guarantee Letter – Pambayad sa Hospital, Gamot, Laboratory Test, Rehabilitation Therapy, Dugo at Dialysis
description: The Mayor's Office issues guarantee letters for patients who need financial assistance to cover hospital bills, medicine, laboratory tests, rehabilitation therapy, blood transfusions, and dialysis sessions.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Partial or final hospital bill (for hospitalization)
Clinical abstract (if requesting for final bill)
Voter's ID or Voter's Certification
Doctor's prescription (for medicine)
Price quotation from accredited pharmacy (for medicine)
Laboratory request (for laboratory tests)
Price quotation from accredited diagnostic clinic or hospital (for laboratory tests)
Doctor's request (for blood transfusion)
Price quotation from accredited dialysis center (for dialysis)
Medical certificate from accredited dialysis center (for dialysis)

clientSteps.action: Submit the required documents to the designated MOPAC staff.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Review the submitted documents for completeness; record the request in the log.

clientSteps.action: Wait for the guarantee letter to be prepared.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Automatically print the Guarantee Letter after confirming the record; obtain approval from the Mayor or an authorized Mayor's Office staff member.

clientSteps.action: Receive the approved Guarantee Letter and bring it to the hospital, laboratory, rehabilitation center, or dialysis center.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Issue the approved Guarantee Letter and provide any necessary instructions to the client.

service: Pagtugon sa reklamo ng nakakatandang mamamayan (OSCA)
officeDivision: Office of the City Mayor - Office for Senior Citizens Affairs (OSCA)
description: The OSCA handles complaints and grievances filed by senior citizens of Calamba against offices, employees, or establishments.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Complaint Form

clientSteps.action: Proceed to the helpdesk to request a complaint form.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Ensure the complainant receives a complaint form.

clientSteps.action: Write down or submit the complaint/grievance in writing.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive the written complaint or grievance; provide a copy to the client; record in the logbook.

clientSteps.action: Wait for the response to the complaint.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Bring the complaint letter to the subject employee or office; await the response; call or text the client with the result or provide a written copy of the response.

service: Pagbibigay ng Pagkakakilanlan ng mga nakatatanda (Senior Citizens ID)

whoMayAvail: Residents of Calamba aged 60 years and above

service: Tulong Pinansyal para sa Nakatatandang Mamamayan – Medical, Hospitalization, at Burial Assistance (OSCA)

officeDivision: Office of the City Mayor - Office for Senior Citizens Affairs (OSCA)
whoMayAvail: Senior citizens who are residents of Calamba

Senior Citizens ID (photocopy)
Hospital bills or statement of accounts (original or certified true copy)
Official receipt of payments made (original)
Voter's ID or Certification (for claimant)
Death Certificate (for burial assistance claims)

Valid ID and Authorization Letter (for claims by a representative)

clientSteps.action: Submit the required documents to the OSCA staff.

processingTime: 13 minuto (initial processing); financial assistance released within 20 working days
notes: Financial assistance is received within twenty (20) working days as it must pass through the Mayor's Office, Budget Office, Accounting Office, and Treasury Office.
